text: Assumption: Via the CancellationHandler, the implementation stops resource-intensive preparations prematurely when the client cancels the conversation — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Via the CancellationHandler, the implementation stops resource-intensive preparations prematurely when the client cancels the conversation — is this correct?
norm: via the cancellationhandler the implementation stops resource intensive preparations prematurely when the client cancels the conversation
assumption: Via the CancellationHandler, the implementation stops resource-intensive preparations prematurely when the client cancels the conversation.
rationale: The specification merely documents that the handler informs about the cancellation, without regulating the exact cancellation behavior in detail.

original.text: Annahme: Interpretation: Über den CancellationHandler dürfte die Implementierung ressourcenintensive Vorbereitungen vorzeitig stoppen, wenn der Client die Konversation abbricht — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Interpretation: Über den CancellationHandler dürfte die Implementierung ressourcenintensive Vorbereitungen vorzeitig stoppen, wenn der Client die Konversation abbricht.
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation dokumentiert lediglich, dass der Handler über den Abbruch informiert, ohne das genaue Abbruchverhalten im Detail zu regeln.
